name: Wszebor
desc: A former sniper of the Lightkeepers who was forced to retire after the Wild Hunt injured his eye. Racking up many feats against the Wild Hunt during the height of his career, although he is no longer able to provide as strong of a support to his teammates, he is confident that they will continue to succeed.

customize.text: Adventure Challenge: Nemesis of the Dark Calamity

<color=#ffd680>Stage Introduction</color>
As a veteran of countless battles, Wszebor knows all too well that only warriors with honed technique and unyielding resolve can prevail against the Abyss. That hard-earned battlefield wisdom has now found its way into his Genius Invokation TCG matches.

A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker."

customize.name: Lucky Coin
customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
